name: Sasquatch Resources Corp.
summary: Sasquatch Resources Corp. is a Canadian entity primarily engaged in mineral exploration. The company holds an exclusive option to acquire complete ownership of the Mount Sicker property, which consists of one contiguous block of 17 mineral claims covering 2,103 hectares within British Columbia's Victoria mining division in Canada. Established in 2021, the firm was previously identified as Scenc Resources Corp. before officially changing its name to Sasquatch Resources Corp. in May 2022. Its operational base is located in Vancouver, Canada.
